hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.tsx?$' || exit 0; ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); TMP=$(mktemp); (cd "$ROOT" && npx vitest related "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" --run --reporter=default) > "$TMP" 2>&1; RC=$?; grep -E '^[[:space:]]*(Test Files|Tests|FAIL)' "$TMP" | head -10; [ $RC -ne 0 ] && echo "(vitest exit $RC; log: $TMP)"; exit 0
